execution: One complete chronological development traversal jointly evaluates three separate $100 books. Merge time_msc, fixed symbol rank, and each symbol source ordinal. Resolve known server expiry, pending activation and SL/TP before timeout, causal completed-bar cancellation and new intents. Never size using an unseen other-symbol quote.
pending: Nonmarketable outward-rounded limit, volume and original stop risk fixed at placement; expiry is 15 minutes from actual submission. No same-ordinal fill or second admission at activation. A gap can activate and immediately stop out at the actual adverse quote. Cancellation cannot erase a completed fill.
geometry: Two-sigma outward stop and conservatively rounded frozen reference take. Immediate entry requires stop strictly beyond current liquidation side and take beyond actual Ask/Bid entry; pending protection is valid relative to its nonmarketable planned entry. Current midpoint recovery also rejects. No spread/geometry predicate is a new signal or parameter search.
marks: Every quote is represented in the ordered account path after its server-side fills/protection and again after economic EA actions. Unchanged equity need not be recomputed when the incoming symbol has no position or cash change. Do not invent a transient favorable pre-target-fill gap peak. Preserve per-series worst peaks/troughs and minute summaries.
financing_and_stress: Dated mode-2 USD/lot swap accrues at crossed raw midnights for the held weekday; captured Friday=5 maps to zero-based weekday 4 for triple. No additional weekend charge. Directional added spread accrues at long entry/short exit; midpoint at half entry/half exit. A third valuation removes all positive financing. No counterfactual stress resizing or unseen future exit charge.
calendar_accounting: Use changes in the last observed marked equity at 2024 and 2025 boundaries, retaining cross-year liabilities. Reconcile actual cash separately to exit-price profit and financing effective timestamps. All actual/stress year gates must pass; complete final flatness is required without a final-row liquidation shortcut.
normal_production_integrity: Every intent is rejected or owns a new instruction; every pending instruction is filled/cancelled/expired; every first fill has one full close. Final price, financing, positive credit, three spread valuations, all cash epochs and lifecycle counts reconcile within 1e-7. Source file/month/row/ordinal is preserved on every fill/exit; financing/expiry record both owned and observing symbols.
output: Normal monthly actions, full closes, equity and restart-attributable book checkpoints under own ignored economics/attempt-01. No score or selection until the entire three-role bundle completes. Numeric tape IDs and millisecond/source integers stay below 2^53; all column schemas are saved.
limitations: Risk-only admission, zero historical commission, dated financing, quote-only fill quantity/latency/depth and explicit same-ms rank remain optimistic proxy limitations. This cannot certify native economics, broker margin/stop-out or exact historical external-session time.
correct_python_compilation: Passed before this freeze; Numba JIT belongs to the ordinary first complete production. No synthetic economic trial, test-only CLI/checker or CI.
